items.question: Why did Marvin have to write his report a second time?
options: A He wrote about the wrong topic from Current Events.
B Mrs. North could not read his writing.
C He did not finish before the bell rang.
D He wrote the report too slowly.

items.question: Mrs. North said that left-handed people have royal blood. How did this make Marvin feel?
options: A Angry, because he still had to copy his report over.
B Sad, because he was the only left-handed student.
C Happy, because it meant he did not need to write neatly.
D Surprised, because he did not know Mrs. North was also left-handed.

items.question: Mrs. North told Marvin to slow down when he wrote. What did Marvin do instead?
options: A He asked a friend to help him write more neatly.
B He stopped writing and went outside to play.
C He wrote as fast as he could to catch up with everyone else.
D He waited for Mrs. North to check his work first.

items.question: What details about Marvin are also true of Prince Robert? Give at least two details AND say where in the chapter you found the answer.
Think about the details at the end of the chapter. Why might Marvin start to wonder if he is really Prince Robert? Use details from the chapter in your answer.
